urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Public, directly downloadable HTTP(S) PDF URLs. One output row per entry; refusals, encrypted/corrupt files and non-PDF responses produce free diagnostics. No login, proxy or block evasion.

ocrLanguages.title: OCR languages
ocrLanguages.description: Tesseract language codes joined with +. Packs installed: eng, deu, fra, spa, ita, por, nld. Default eng+deu. Used only for pages without a usable text layer.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Reject larger documents as uncharged diagnostics; never truncate or charge a partial PDF.

pdfTimeoutSeconds.title: Time limit per PDF
pdfTimeoutSeconds.description: Total download and extraction budget per PDF; timeouts produce uncharged diagnostics.

runBudgetSeconds.title: Run work budget
runBudgetSeconds.description: Stop starting PDF work after this budget and write uncharged diagnostics for remaining URLs. The Store timeout includes startup/flush overhead.
